title: kith-chat: tests for all owner methods
description:
What: Comprehensive test suite for all 10 owner method handlers in kith-chat crate.

Note: Individual method tests are already specified in each implementation bead. This bead adds:
1. Cross-method integration tests (e.g., create contact, create chat, send message, query — end-to-end within kith-chat crate using in-memory store).
2. Auth rejection tests (critical — must not be self-certifying).
3. Cross-input security invariant tests.

Test groups:

GROUP A — Cross-method workflow:
- Test 1: Contact/set create → Contact/get → Contact/query → Contact/changes (verify state sequence).
- Test 2: Chat/set create → Chat/get → Chat/query → Chat/changes.
- Test 3: Message/set create → Message/get → Message/query (with chatId) → Message/changes.
- Test 4: Full sequence: contact → chat → message → readAt → queryChanges.

GROUP B — Auth rejection (non-self-certifying):
- Test 5: All owner methods reject when called with Role::Peer (method should return forbiddenMethod error from Dispatcher role check).
- Test 6: All peer methods reject when called with Role::Owner.
- These must use the Dispatcher directly, not bypass it, to test the actual role gate.

GROUP C — Security invariants:
- Test 7: Message/set create with body exactly 65536 bytes → success.
- Test 8: Message/set create with body 65537 bytes → notCreated/invalidArguments.
- Test 9: Message/set create with wrong chatId (doesn't match any chat) → notCreated/notFound.
- Test 10: Contact/changes with sinceState from future (s-99999) → state_mismatch or empty.
- Test 11: Message/query without chatId in filter → invalidArguments.

All oracle values must be hand-constructed from RFC 8620 text and kith-core serde field names — no test may derive expected values from the code under test.

Agent team:
- Agent R: Read existing tests in kith-store/tests/ for patterns. Read kith-jmap/src/lib.rs (Dispatcher) to understand how to test via Dispatcher (not bypass).
- Agent I: Implement tests in kith-chat/tests/integration.rs.
- Agent T: Design test vectors independently. Confirm expected JMAP field names from RFC 8620 §5 (e.g., 'methodResponses', 'accountId', 'list', 'notFound', 'state').
- Agent V: cargo test -p kith-chat && clippy && fmt.

Critical: Tests MUST NOT pass by testing the method's output against its own internal state. Use a second independent read to verify. For example: write via /set, then read via /get with known expected fields, not by calling the same /set logic again.
